Definition: from G4314 and G2820; to give a common lot to, i.e. (figuratively) to associate with:--consort with.
BiblicalUsage: Proskleroo means to join oneself to, to cast in one's lot with. It appears once, in Athens: certain men clave unto Paul, and believed, among whom was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the men who joined Paul that day did the bravest thing in Athens: they left the crowd of mockers and cast their lot with the preacher of the resurrection.
